coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured AI blog redirects to Microsoft Source AI. Dates were not reliably paired with titles, and the configured feed returned HTTP 410. The separate AI topic feed returned ten entries, most recently September 10, outside this window. A different, all-site Source feed spanned October 1–7 and included three AI or Surface candidates, but does not establish complete coverage of the configured AI feed. Rendered cards included titles without verifiable dates. Reading the selected NVIDIA announcement is separate from complete list coverage; these gaps do not establish an absence of updates.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The old GitHub blog’s latest visible date is September 23, 2025. The current research page’s first screen includes September 3, 18, and 20, 2026, with Qwen Image 2.1 dated September 20. Pagination and filtering were not exhausted. Static page data still contains older 2025 dates, and retrieval returned no entries. Hugging Face, GitHub, and ModelScope release channels were not comprehensively covered. These checks cannot establish an absence of newer releases.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The official page returned HTTP 200 and two news links, without paired titles and publication dates. The rendered follow-up produced a Cloudflare 1001 DNS error and no readable dynamic news list. Access to a response body does not establish full dated coverage or an absence of updates.
coverage_gaps.DeepSeek: The API news list most recently shows September 10; Chinese and English news pages and Harness materials were found, with a September 29 entry. The organization view showed 44 repositories and a latest push on October 3, before the main window; the local top-100 sorted check found no push in the 05:00–06:00 increment. Repository push times are not announcement dates. Releases across all repositories were not checked, and Harness’s first release date remains unverified. The organization’s other entry points are incompletely covered.
coverage_gaps.月之暗面 Moonshot: The homepage shows a July 17 entry, while the alternative Kimi blog redirects and shows July 31, both before this window. All articles were not traversed, and a complete dated publication list was not established. Homepage access does not establish an absence of updates.
coverage_gaps.智谱 Z.ai: The visible news list most recently shows September 10, and the research list August 26. Not all papers were read; English Z.ai, GitHub, and Hugging Face release channels were not exhaustively checked. Undated model-navigation entries are not publication dates. This is incomplete list coverage, not a claim that the organization had no updates.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The initial response was a small page shell. The rendered site showed Step 5 Preview, Step 3.7 Flash, Step 3.5 Flash, and StepAudio 3, with a six-day open-source countdown but no verifiable absolute publication date. The previous check showed eight days. A changing countdown is neither a completed release nor grounds for assigning October 14 as a release date. Streaming and other release channels remain incompletely covered.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: Three homepage announcements were dated February 13, March 23, and September 24, 2026, before this window. The homepage listed 1,085 active venues and 173 open-submission venues, without new-paper timestamps. Updates and papers across all individual venues were not traversed, so this does not establish that the platform had no new submissions.
coverage_gaps.字节跳动 Seed·博客与论文: Separate visible lists showed research dated August 5, foundation models June 23, vision July 31, audio August 5, frontier research July 7, papers August 18, and an AI infrastructure entry dated August 14, 2025. Only first-page lists were checked, and dates for some infrastructure cards remain incomplete. Product navigation is undated; not all article bodies or organizational updates were read. These entry points do not establish complete coverage or an absence of updates.
coverage_gaps.MiniMax·News & Updates: The visible news list most recently shows August 26, before the window, with older entries including August 3. Navigation exposed M3, M2.7, Speech 2.8, Music 3.0, and H3; separately inspected release material carried older May–August dates. Complete coverage of every product release was not established. Load-more results, the Chinese MiniMax.cn news channel, and all article bodies were not exhaustively read. These gaps do not establish an absence of organizational updates.
